reviews.comment: Very easy class as long as you keep up and do the work. There are 3 major projects but they are all pretty easy and fair. Her grading is great and is very lenient. Only thing is communication is rough for projects, I recommended looking at what you have to do 2 days prior the deadline for time to email and get an answer back.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Textbook provided. Grades weren't released until after midterms. This online course seemed to be created by a collaboration of profs in the Engl Dept, not Dr. Zhang herself. Her class is doable, but it took a lot of time. However, I tend to revise a lot on English assignments. I don't think she is a tough grader. Spring '22 Review
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The amount of homework she gives is so mid. Its super easy its literally a completion grade. There are at most 3 homeworks a week and theyre just discussion posts and responding to them. Its so easy and she answers her emails quickly. Take her shes great, cares, and wants everyone to get an A.

Honestly, don't take this for an English credit....It's just a lot of work. A TON of assignments due each week. Some take like 15 minutes, others no so much. Huge group project that lasts for the last half of the semester. Some of the instructions are kinda confusing. Dr.Zhang also doesn't grade very often at all so it's hard to know your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Took ENGL 210 online over 5-week summer session. Since it was online, she only updated the class through emails and graded our papers. I thought her grading was fair and the class to be fairly easy. Make sure you stay on top of your essays each week if you are taking 210 over the summer. If you put effort into your writing, you should get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria
